content.title: The Michigan Wolverines are national champs, shop 2026 NCAA championship gear
content.text: Updated April 6, 2026, 11:38 p.m. ETThe Michigan Wolverines won the 2026 NCAA men's basketball National Championship.Michigan defeated the UConn Huskies with a final score of 69-63.This is the Wolverines' second national title and their first since 1989.Elliot Cadeau led Michigan in scoring with 19 points.The Michigan Wolverines are back at the top of the college basketball world as the 2026 NCAA men's basketball National Champions!The Wolverines defeated the legendary Dan Hurley and his UConn Huskies, 69-63, en route to the team's second ever title and first since 1989.SHOP: Michigan 2026 National Champions gearUConn was looking for their third championship in four years, but that dynasty will have to wait.
